name: 3P - order tracking
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3P - order tracking.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Redirect helper only. Configure your order-help page or provider URL. It does not authenticate customers or retrieve order/shipment data. Enable email only if required by the provider; values are sent in the destination URL.
